messages:
sasha: FYI we flipped the fncall schema gate to hard-reject for the new typed-tool canary and saw an immediate uptick in 4xxs reported in the console. Roughly 0.6% of requests in the slice. Most come from partner-y adapters. Need quick ops plan.

jordy: Which field is failing mostly?

sasha: `result` field. Canary expects an object {id: int, body: string} but some adapters return a union or null. Dashboard shows spikes grouped by route_id but we don't have partner breakdown yet.

leila: Validator owner here. We enabled strict to catch regressions early. Were sampling knobs enabled for the reject logs? I want to avoid double-counting when we backfill.

park: I can add partner labels to the telemetry. For mitigation: do we want a compatibility shim (coerce array->object where possible) or a routing quarantine to a compat model?

sasha: Short term: avoid breaking customers. Long term: enforce upgrade. Proposal: revert hard-reject to a pass-through with a `validation_issue` header so callers see a warning but not an error. That keeps our metrics.

leila: Alternative: route traffic from known legacy vendors to `tool-legacy-v1` via runtime route rules. That prevents churn for other partners. But building the routing list takes time.

jordy: Can we do both? Immediate toggle to pass-through + create a quarantine routing tag that ops can add to partners as we identify them.

park: Example bad payload from logs:
```json
{"tool": "summarize", "result": null, "meta": {"client": "partner-y"}}
```
We expected: `{ "result": {"id": 42, "body": "..."}}`. Nulls are causing JSON schema reject.

leila: I'll push a hotfix to set gate mode = "warn" for the canary route_id. It will emit metric `fncall.schema_warns` and set response header `X-Fncall-Validation: warn`. No status code change.

sasha: Deploy-bot, can you schedule a quick rollbackable change? We want the change only on canary slice for now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling patch requested by @leila. Canary toggle queued. CI ok. ETA 7m. :rocket:

jordy: Ops: please add a dashboard tile that breaks `schema_warns` by `meta.client` and `route_id`. Right now model-level view masks partner hotspots.

park: Will do. Also will start a cron to sample 0.5% of warn payloads to s3://fncall/validation-samples with partner and route tags (PII redaction).

sasha: For backlog: we should spec a compat-shim library in the adapter SDK so partners can opt-in, and a runtime route matcher for quarantine lists.

leila: Hotfix live, gate set to warn for route 0xabc. Telemetry shows warn metric incrementing but no client errors. Sampling hook active.

jordy: Thanks. Can someone take ownership of the partner triage? Need top offenders so we can apply routing quaratine or reach out.

park: I'll compile a list by tomorrow morning and tag account team.

sasha: Good. We'll re-evaluate after 24h and decide whether to migrate offending partners to `tool-legacy-v1` or require adapter changes. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
